title: Initials of members
statementMd:
Show each member's initials (first letter of the first name plus first letter of the last name, for example `AT` for Alan Turing).

Expected columns: `name`, `initials`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `substr(name, 1, 1)` and the character after the space: `substr(name, instr(name, ' ') + 1, 1)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, substr(name, 1, 1) || substr(name, instr(name, ' ') + 1, 1) AS initials FROM members;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
